$comment: Machine-readable spec produced by the v5 pipeline for the worked example in before_after_notes.md. Demonstrates the shape a v5-compliant output takes.

design_dna.signature_concept: the page reads like a well-designed technical memo; the product is engineering evidence, not spectacle
design_dna.typography_direction: one variable grotesk with real weight range (300 body, 380 large calm display, 400 editorial captions, 620 headlines); tabular figures for data
design_dna.color_direction: warm off-white surface + one deep anchor + one small chroma point used only in data numerals and one link state
design_dna.geometry_direction: editorial 8-column grid desktop; single column with wide margin mobile; content-driven symmetry per section
design_dna.motion_direction: dominant static; one media-crop reveal as the only motion device

regions.shape: editorial single sentence offset to left columns of 8-col grid; live product number in right columns; one CTA; no eyebrow
regions.containment_reason: hero is a region, not a card; grid alignment carries structure

regions.shape: two-column: 60ch paragraph left, annotated data-flow diagram right
regions.containment: diagram is contained (media edge); paragraph is not
regions.containment_reason: diagram bounds must be respected; paragraph is text and needs no box

regions.shape: single real product screenshot with editorial caption above
regions.containment: media is contained by its own bounds; no extra frame

regions.shape: long paragraph in comfortable measure, wide margins, no other elements
three-tier table; primary tier emphasized by weight + subtle surface tint
regions.containment: tier rows are functional units, but styled by surface not by border

regions.shape: two-column: address+support+email left, matched CTA from hero right

composition.mobile_recomposition: single column with wide side margin; hero becomes stacked media-first then copy; two-column sections stack in content-priority order

containment_decisions.job: bound annotated media so labels associate with parts
emphasize primary tier as selectable primary option

scroll_mapping.product_surface: media-crop reveal from tight framing to full width when section enters at 30% viewport

motion.mobile_variant: media-crop reveal reduced to opacity fade only; no crop travel
motion.reduced_motion_variant: media-crop reveal replaced with static crop; no travel
motion.technology: native scroll-driven animation via CSS; no GSAP required

authenticity_gate.notes: the page is less decorated than the v4-style default and reads as more considered; every visible element does a job
